info.title: CustomTheme
info.description: Themes in the help center are pre-defined templates that let you customize its appearance by adjusting colors, fonts, images, and even modifying HTML and CSS for advanced customization. You can further enhance your help center by adding custom scripts, including JavaScript functions and inline scripts, alongside HTML and CSS.

get.description: Retrieves custom theme details by the given custom theme ID.

patch.description: Updates a custom theme for a help center.

delete.description: Deletes the specified custom theme. An enabled theme cannot be deleted.

get.description: Retrieves all custom themes for a help center, with pagination support.

parameters.name: defaultThemeId
parameters.description: Filter custom themes by base theme template

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of custom themes to list

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number starting from which the custom themes must be listed

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: Filter custom themes by help center

post.description: Applies or drafts a custom theme for a help center.

parameters.name: helpCenterId
parameters.description: Filter default content by help center

post.description: Updates and publishes a custom theme draft for a help center.

get.description: Retrieves tabs from a custom theme. Response may include metadata fields like name, modifiedBy, and modifiedTime; these fields are response-only and must not be sent in CustomTheme write request payload tabs.
